'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****[[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland forces]] capture key locations, including Dararmadobe, Uraar and the Four Corners of Mountains in Gaatir Oodan, which have served as command and defense bases for the [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State militias]]. Troops uncover mass graves, including the bodies of senior Middle East [[ISIL]] members killed in [[United Arab Emirates Air Force|UAE]] and [[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|US airstrikes]]. Vehicles and motorbikes rigged with explosives were found in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains of [[Puntland|Puntland's]] [[Bari Region]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/puntland/somalia-mass-graves-discovered-in-puntland-as-isis-lose-grounds (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200395/puntland_forces_capture_key_isis_strongholds_in_al_miskaat_mountains.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***The [[Ryazan Refinery]] in [[Ryazan]], [[Russia]], suspends operations after an overnight [[drone warfare|drone attack]] by [[Ukraine]] destroys the main [[atmospheric distillation of crude oil#Atmospheric crude distillation unit|crude distillation unit]] at the facility. Locals report hearing at least five explosions during the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-ryazan-oil-refinery-halts-operations-after-drone-strike-sources-say-2025-02-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Sectarianism and minorities in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Druze]] militia leaders announce the formation of the [[Suwayda Military Council]] as a coalition of [[Southern Syria|southern Syrian forces]] for promoting regional [[Secularism|secularism]] and [[Democracy|democracy]]. The council accuses the [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian transitional government]] of committing [[Ethnic cleansing|ethnic cleansing]] operations and [[Extrajudicial killing|extrajudicial killings]], and vows to prevent [[Syrian Armed Forces]] from entering [[Druze in Syria|Druze settlements]]. [https://elmanshar.com/2025/02/24/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7/ (El Manshar)] [https://elmanshar.com/2025/02/23/%d8%aa%d8%b4%d9%83%d9%8a%d9%84-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%ac%d9%84%d8%b3-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%b3%d9%83%d8%b1%d9%8a-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%88%d9%8a%d8%af%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%af%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%b2/ (El Manshar 2)]
*[[2020s European re-armament]]
**[[Chancellor of Germany|German chancellor-in-waiting]]  [[Friedrich Merz]] declares the rapid re-[[militarization]] of [[Germany]] and [[Europe]] as a whole to be an immediate priority, in order to provide [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|military support]] for [[Ukraine]] against [[Russia]], as well as to pursue European military independence from the [[United States]] and possibly [[NATO]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpv4n0dg3v3o (BBC News)]
*[[Terrorism in France]]
**Three [[molotov cocktail]]s are thrown at the [[List of diplomatic missions of Russia|Russian consulate]] in [[Marseille]], [[France]]. No perpetrators are apprehended, but [[National Police (France)|police]] suspect [[terrorism]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20250224-russia-demands-investigation-into-explosions-heard-at-marseille-consulate (France24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*American [[coffeehouse]] chain [[Starbucks]] announces that it is cutting 1,100 jobs across its stores in the [[United States]] as part of [[cost reduction]] measures. The company also announces that its menu will be "simplified" and shrunk by 33%. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3rnq2lv1lzo (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Health in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**Over 50 people die after [[2025 Equateur disease outbreak|an unknown virus outbreak]] in northwestern [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/an-unknown-illness-kills-over-50-people-in-part-of-congo-with-hours-between-symptoms-and-death/ (CTV News)]
*[[Measles resurgence in the United States]]
**The [[Texas Department of State Health Services|Department of State Health Services]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]], places several major cities in the state on high alert due to a [[measles]] outbreak that spreads to 99 people in Texas and [[New Mexico]], the third-largest [[disease outbreak|outbreak]] since it was considered [[Eradication of infectious diseases#Measles|eliminated]] in the U.S. in 2000. [https://www.tpr.org/public-health/2025-02-23/breaking-news-possible-measles-exposures-in-san-antonio (Texas Public Radio)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/texas-measles-outbreak-symptoms-vaccine-b2703631.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[UN General Assembly|General Assembly]] votes 93–18, with 65 [[abstention]]s, to pass a resolution condemning Russia's [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|war]] against Ukraine. The 18 countries that voted against include the [[United States]], [[Russia]], [[Israel]], [[Belarus]], and [[North Korea]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2025/02/24/politics/us-joins-russia-ukraine-un-vote (CNN)] [https://www.npr.org/2025/02/24/g-s1-50473/un-ukraine-resolution-russia (NPR)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Australia]]n [[Australian Communications and Media Authority|eSafety Commission]] fines [[instant messaging]] service [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] [[Australian dollar|A$]]1 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]640,000) for delaying its response to inquiries on preventing [[Online child abuse|child exploitation]] and [[Online youth radicalization|extremist]] content. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-fines-telegram-delay-answering-child-abuse-terror-questions-2025-02-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] formally announces that [[asteroid]] [[2024 YR4]] now poses "no significant threat" to [[Earth]] in [[2032]] and beyond as the chances of an impact drop to 1-in-59,000 (0.0017%). This means a [[Asteroid impact avoidance|planetary defense]] mission to intercept and deflect the object in 2028 during a [[Flyby (spaceflight)|close flyby]] of Earth is no longer necessary. [https://blogs.nasa.gov/planetarydefense/2025/02/24/latest-calculations-conclude-asteroid-2024-yr4-now-poses-no-significant-threat-to-earth-in-2032-and-beyond/ (NASA)] [https://arstechnica.com/space/2025/02/asteroid-2024-yr4-may-be-a-dud-but-we-will-soon-find-many-more-threats/ (Ars Technica)]
